operation: most recently selected row on a native caret move (deletion of the caret row)
candidate: lazy merge cursor: rows with their own selection stamp (sorted once per deletion) merged with one reverse-preorder walk per selectAll epoch
rationale: exact stock order (60 oracle cases); O(m log m) for m stamped facades plus the rows actually read; cold rows of a selectAll pattern need no per-row state

operation: most recently selected row on a native caret move
candidate: doubly linked LRU list of selected rows (LeetCode 146 LRU Cache shape)
rationale: needs a node per selected row, also for every cold row a selectAll selects (O(rows) allocation for selectAll over 10^6 rows); the pattern is already ordered by preorder

operation: most recently selected row on a native caret move
candidate: max-heap of (stamp, row) with lazy deletion (LeetCode 295 / 1046 shape)
rationale: same per-row materialization as the list; the merge cursor reads in order without a heap

operation: selectAll pattern per parent with the epoch of each covered child
candidate: sorted segments {limit, epoch}, linear scan (one segment unless selectAll ran again over more children)
rationale: O(segments) lookup, almost always 1; insert/remove shifts limits, shrink clamps them, trailing deselection shortens the last limit without a facade

operation: rows a shrink past the caret deselects
candidate: per-move simulation: front pointer = caret walking the removed children, back pointer = recency cursor
rationale: exact for the cascade through surviving rows once the pointers meet (oracle 'caret 150 sel all shrink 160': 75 survivors deselected); O(moves + rows read)

operation: geometry of a resident anchor row outside the paint window
candidate: (logical row - top row) x item height
rationale: O(1); same mapping as the probe row

operation: native handle validation before a state write
candidate: HashMap handle -> plan entry plus lParam check
rationale: O(1); the TreeView reuses handles, so identity needs both checks
